shortDescription: Some holders of Senegal’s eurobonds are forming a creditor group and have chosen White & Case LLP as legal adviser ahead of debt-restructuring talks with the country, people familiar with the matter said, according to Bloomberg.

title: Senegal Eurobond Holders Hire White & Case for Restructuring Talks
